verdict.rationale: Whether user data is used for model training is a fair question for an SDK that sends prompts and traces to a model provider, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented training opt-out or no-training data policy. The env var that disables tracing is an adjacent control, not a training-data control. Provider-agnostic model support is only a user-side workaround.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
